name: gh-xeb
description: MCP server exposing GitHub CLI extension (gh xeb) as tools

tools_categories.vault: Vault operations - query secrets and capabilities
tools_categories.backstage: Backstage catalog operations - query entities and run templates

setup: Ensure gh-xeb extension is installed: gh extension install 0xHackerSpace/gh-xeb
Ensure gh is authenticated: gh auth login
Tools may require VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN to be set for vault operations
permissions: gh-xeb has full access to GitHub APIs through gh CLI
gh-xeb can read Vault secrets if authenticated
Side-effecting operations like 'backstage create' are marked
sensitive_data: Tokens and credentials are never printed in tool output
Use --mask flag with 'vault get' to protect secret values
Tool schemas do not expose default values that contain secrets
